name: @djgrant/chatgpt/send
description: Types a message into the logged-out chatgpt.com chat, sends it, waits for the reply, and returns the updated conversation. Requires allow-writes. Not idempotent: a retry sends the message again.

writes: chatgpt.com (sends a message in the logged-out chat)

resolve.prompt: This is a chatgpt.com conversation page. Return {turns, response}. turns is an array of {role, text} in reading order, where role is 'user' for messages under 'You said:' and 'assistant' for messages under 'ChatGPT said:'. response is the text of the last assistant turn — the response to the message just sent — or null when there is none. If no conversation is visible, return {turns: [], response: null}.
